texts: On day 60 of Year 1, about four sky-cats were visible on the cliff-spires in the morning.
In a normal autumn about ten sky-cats are visible on the cliff-spires in the morning.
A handful of sky-cats had been visible on the cliff-spires for two weeks.
A handful of sky-cats had hunted on the Cliff Path in those two weeks.
A handful of sky-cats had molted in those two weeks.
Tessa Brae collected about twelve feathers per morning during those two weeks.
In a normal autumn Tessa Brae collects about thirty-five feathers per morning.

q1_issues.issue: sk_weeks_1 is minted as a referent for "those two weeks" but never given a class atom, so an untyped referent symbol appears in the output and then fills slots at 39, 46 and 57.
The Time role is filled with an entity witness (sk_weeks_1 here and at 46; sk_autumn_1/sk_autumn_2 at 21 and 68) rather than a structured calendar term or a named/deictic time constant.
(During sk_collect_1 sk_weeks_1) nests the collecting inside something that is not a reified eventuality, while During is specified as relating two reified eventualities.
The three past-perfect clauses (had been visible / had hunted / had molted) emit Past but no Before ordering, although the passage supplies the day-60 visibility event for them to precede.

q2_gaps: Approximated cardinal count ("about four sky-cats", "about ten", "about twelve feathers", "about thirty-five"): Cardinality takes a native integer, ParticleFromNormal is defined only for Measure/Time magnitudes, and CardinalityPhrase is defined for vague quantities with no exact number normalized to a canonical lexicon string.

Normalcy-baseline framing ("In a normal autumn about ten sky-cats are visible ...") — a typical/expected value under normal conditions; there is no typicality operator, and the indefinite-witness route asserts one particular autumn.

Anaphoric multi-unit time-span NP ("in those two weeks", "during those two weeks"): term propagation is specified for single day-level or coarser calendar terms, not for a stated N-unit interval, so the span has no licensed referent or Time filler.
Day-of-year dating in a fictional calendar ("On day 60 of Year 1"): (Day n) is defined as a calendar day inside a month/date, not a day ordinal within a year.

Quantity-per-time-unit rate on an event's object ("about twelve feathers per morning"): TimesPer counts occurrences and the compound <unit>_per_<unit> Measure form is defined for a bearer's own magnitude, so the "twelve per morning" binding has no single licensed carrier.
review.notes: Roles, compound decomposition (sky_cat/cliff_spire), group + per-member distribution handling, and the reified-state route for "were visible" all follow the instruction set; the weak points are concentrated in the temporal encoding. Approximated counts were routed to CardinalityPhrase with non-lexicon strings ("about four"), which no seeded phrase rule can map back to a bound.

issues.reason: Names and casing states that a minted witness's class atom is always emitted and that an untyped referent symbol must never appear in the output, yet sk_weeks_1 carries only a Measure and then fills three slots.

The sk_weeks_1 half stands (an untyped symbol in the Time slot, with the passage already reifying the two-week state sk_visible_3 to anchor on), but sk_autumn_1/sk_autumn_2 are typed witnesses in genuine gap territory -- Time's term inventory has no season term and a bare autumn constant would silently drop the stated 'normal' restriction -- so those atoms are acceptable improvisation.

Intervals specifies During as nesting one reified eventuality inside another, both reified, and sk_weeks_1 is neither reified nor an eventuality, while the passage supplies sk_visible_3 (the two-week visibility state) as a licensed outer argument.

Real that the passage contains other asserted events so the 'no other event in the text' exemption does not apply, but overstated as a violation: the rule's positive trigger is sentence-internal ('whenever the sentence contains another asserted event') and each past perfect is its own single-clause sentence, and a Before on the continuative 'had been visible for two weeks' would be false since that state runs up to the day-60 reference time.

gaps_confirmed: Approximated cardinal count ('about four', 'about twelve'): Cardinality takes a native integer, ParticleFromNormal is defined only for Measure/Time magnitudes, and CardinalityPhrase is for vague quantities normalized to a canonical lexicon string -- so 'about four' has no carrier that a seeded rule can map to a bound.
Normalcy-baseline framing ('In a normal autumn ...'): no typicality operator exists, and the default indefinite-witness route asserts one particular autumn.

Anaphoric multi-unit time-span NP: term propagation yields calendar terms and Time's inventory has no span term, so 'in those two weeks' has no licensed Time filler (only the 'during' variant has the During-over-the-antecedent-eventuality route).
Day-of-year dating in a fictional calendar ('day 60 of Year 1'): (Day n) is defined as a calendar day inside a month/date, not a day ordinal within a year.

Quantity-per-time-unit rate on an event's object ('about twelve feathers per morning'): TimesPer counts occurrences and the <unit>_per_<unit> compound is for a bearer's own magnitude, so the per-morning quantity has no single licensed carrier.
new_gaps: Past-bounded habitual ('collected about twelve feathers per morning during those two weeks'): Frequency & habitual schedules requires the event to stay unmarked, giving no licensed way to bound a habit to a closed past interval while the clause is finite past tense -- a licensed form would need to carry the recurrence, the tense, and the enclosing interval on one eventuality.

Restricted period adverbial in the Time slot ('in a normal autumn'): a licensed form would need a Time filler that both names a season-level period and carries the 'normal' restriction, since the bare-constant route drops the qualifier and the witness route asserts a particular autumn.
adjudication.defect_summary: Issue 0: any minted referent must carry a class atom, so 'those two weeks' would have to be a typed definite-plural group ((GroupOf sk_weeks_1 week) (Cardinality sk_weeks_1 2)) or, better, resolved to the already-reified two-week state sk_visible_3 so that no bare span symbol is minted at all. Issue 2: the compliant form is (During sk_collect_1 sk_visible_3), nesting the collecting inside the reified two-week visibility eventuality the passage itself supplies.
adjudication.notes: Compound decomposition (sky_cat/cliff_spire), the Cliff Path name/type pair, group + per-member distribution, and the reified-state route for 'were visible' are all correct; the damage is confined to the invented span referent. The CardinalityPhrase strings 'about four'/'about twelve' are non-lexicon improvisations but keep a hedge that dropping would widen the claim, so they stand under the calibration line.
